about: RHI Magnesita India Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of refractories, monolithics, bricks, and ceramic paper in India and internationally. The company offers isostatically pressed continuous casting refractories, slide gate plates, nozzles and well blocks, tundish nozzles, bottom purging refractories and top purging lances, slag arresting darts, castables, and high alumina bricks, and magnesia carbon bricks, as well as spray mass for tundish working linings.
